problems.title: Sum of Two Numbers
problems.statement: Given two integers **A** and **B**, print their sum.
problems.inputDescription: One line with two space-separated integers A and B.

problems.title: Maximum of Three
problems.statement: Given three integers **A**, **B**, and **C**, print the largest value.
problems.inputDescription: One line with three space-separated integers.
problems.outputDescription: Print one integer: max(A, B, C).

problems.title: Count Positive Numbers
problems.statement: Given **N** integers, count how many are strictly greater than zero.
problems.inputDescription: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
problems.outputDescription: Print the count of positive numbers.
problems.constraints: 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5, each value fits in 32-bit signed integer

problems.title: GCD of Two Numbers
problems.statement: Given two positive integers **A** and **B**, print their greatest common divisor.
problems.inputDescription: One line with two space-separated positive integers.

problems.title: Largest Permutation
problems.statement: Given **N** digits (0–9), rearrange them to form the largest possible number (no leading zeros unless the number is zero).
problems.inputDescription: First line: N. Second line: N digits separated by spaces.
problems.outputDescription: Print the largest number as a decimal string.

problems.title: Sort Descending
problems.statement: Given **N** integers, print them sorted in non-increasing order.
problems.inputDescription: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
problems.outputDescription: Print the sorted integers in descending order, space-separated.

problems.title: Binary Search Position
problems.statement: A sorted array of **N** distinct integers and a target **X** are given. Print the 0-based index of **X**, or **-1** if **X** is not present.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N and X. Line 2: N sorted space-separated integers.
problems.outputDescription: Print the index of X, or -1.

problems.title: First True Index
problems.statement: A boolean array of length **N** is sorted: all `false` values come before all `true` values. Find the index of the first `true`, or **-1** if none exist. Input uses 0/1 (0 = false, 1 = true).
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Line 2: N values (0 or 1).
problems.outputDescription: Print the first index with value 1, or -1.

problems.title: Max Sum Subarray of Length K
problems.statement: Given an array of **N** integers and an integer **K**, find the maximum sum among all contiguous subarrays of length exactly **K**.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N and K. Line 2: N integers.

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.statement: You can climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. Given **N** steps, how many distinct ways are there to reach the top?
problems.inputDescription: One integer N.
problems.outputDescription: Print the number of ways modulo is not needed — values fit in 64-bit integer for given constraints.

problems.title: Coin Change Minimum
problems.statement: Given coin denominations and a target amount **A**, find the minimum number of coins needed to make exactly **A**, or **-1** if impossible.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: number of coin types C and amount A. Line 2: C coin values.

problems.title: 0/1 Knapsack
problems.statement: Given **N** items with weights and values, and a knapsack capacity **W**, maximize total value without exceeding capacity. Each item can be taken at most once.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N and W. Next N lines: weight and value per item.

problems.title: Grid Shortest Path Length
problems.statement: In an **R×C** grid, `.` is walkable and `#` is blocked. Find the shortest path length from top-left (0,0) to bottom-right (R-1,C-1), moving only up/down/left/right. Print **-1** if unreachable.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: R and C. Next R lines: grid rows.
problems.outputDescription: Print shortest path length (number of steps), or -1.

problems.title: Connected Components
problems.statement: Given an undirected graph with **N** nodes (1-indexed) and **M** edges, count the number of connected components.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N and M. Next M lines: edges u v.
problems.outputDescription: Print the number of connected components.

problems.title: Tree Maximum Depth
problems.statement: Given a rooted tree with **N** nodes (root = 1), parent array style: for each node 2..N, its parent is given. Print the maximum depth (root depth = 1).
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Line 2: N-1 parent indices for nodes 2..N.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.statement: Given a string containing only `(`, `)`, `{`, `}`, `[` and `]`, determine if the brackets are balanced and correctly nested.
problems.inputDescription: One line: bracket string.

problems.title: Reverse Words
problems.statement: Given a line of text, reverse the order of words (words are separated by single spaces; no leading/trailing spaces).
problems.inputDescription: One line of text.
problems.outputDescription: Print words in reverse order, space-separated.

problems.title: Modular Exponentiation
problems.statement: Compute **A^B mod M**.
problems.inputDescription: One line: A B M.

problems.title: Minimum Array Element
problems.statement: Given **N** integers, print the smallest value in the array.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Line 2: N space-separated integers.

problems.title: Power of Two
problems.statement: Given a positive integer **N**, print `YES` if **N** is a power of two, otherwise `NO`. (1 is considered a power of two.)
problems.inputDescription: One positive integer N.

problems.title: Fibonacci Number
problems.statement: The Fibonacci sequence is defined by F(1)=1, F(2)=1, and F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2) for n>2. Given **N**, print F(N).
problems.inputDescription: One integer N (1-indexed).

problems.title: Palindrome String
problems.statement: Given a lowercase string **S**, determine whether it reads the same forwards and backwards.
problems.inputDescription: One lowercase string S.
problems.outputDescription: Print YES if palindrome, otherwise NO.

problems.title: Count Primes Up To N
problems.statement: Count how many prime numbers are less than or equal to **N**.
problems.inputDescription: One integer N.

problems.title: Two Sum Exists
problems.statement: Given **N** integers and a target **T**, determine if any two distinct elements sum to **T**.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N and T. Line 2: N integers.
problems.outputDescription: Print YES if such a pair exists, otherwise NO.

problems.title: Maximum Subarray Sum
problems.statement: Given an array of **N** integers (may include negatives), find the maximum possible sum of any non-empty contiguous subarray.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Line 2: N integers.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.statement: Given a lowercase string **S**, find the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated character.
problems.inputDescription: One lowercase string S.

problems.title: Merge Overlapping Intervals
problems.statement: Given **N** closed intervals [L, R], merge all overlapping intervals and print how many intervals remain after merging.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Next N lines: L R per interval.
problems.outputDescription: Print the count after merging overlaps.

problems.title: House Robber
problems.statement: Along a street, house **i** has value V_i. You cannot rob two adjacent houses. Maximize the total value you can rob.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Line 2: N non-negative integers.

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
problems.statement: Given non-negative bar heights, compute how many units of water can be trapped between bars after rain.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Line 2: N heights.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.statement: Given an array of **N** integers, find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence (not necessarily contiguous).
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Line 2: N integers.

problems.title: Maximum Product Subarray
problems.statement: Find the maximum product of any non-empty contiguous subarray. The answer fits in a signed 64-bit integer for the given constraints.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Line 2: N integers.

problems.title: Edit Distance
problems.statement: Given strings **A** and **B**, find the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, or replacements to transform **A** into **B**.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: string A. Line 2: string B.

problems.title: Rotten Oranges
problems.statement: In a grid, `0` = empty, `1` = fresh orange, `2` = rotten. Each minute, rotten oranges rot adjacent fresh ones (4-directional). Print minimum minutes until no fresh orange remains, or **-1** if impossible.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: R and C. Next R lines: grid rows as strings of digits.

problems.title: Course Schedule Possible
problems.statement: There are **N** courses (1..N) and prerequisite pairs (A, B) meaning B must be taken before A. Print `YES` if all courses can be finished, otherwise `NO`.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N and M. Next M lines: course prerequisite pairs A B.

problems.title: Dijkstra Shortest Path
problems.statement: Given a weighted directed graph with **N** nodes (1-indexed) and **M** edges, find the shortest distance from node **S** to node **T**. Print **-1** if unreachable.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N M S T. Next M lines: u v w (edge u→v weight w).

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.statement: Given strings **A** and **B**, find the length of their longest common subsequence (not necessarily contiguous).
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: string A. Line 2: string B.

problems.title: Matrix Chain Multiplication
problems.statement: Given **N** matrices with dimensions in order (rows of matrix i = cols of matrix i-1), find the minimum number of scalar multiplications needed to multiply all matrices together.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N. Line 2: N+1 dimensions d0 d1 ... dN where matrix i has size di-1 × di.

problems.title: Strongly Connected Components
problems.statement: Given a directed graph with **N** nodes and **M** edges, count the number of strongly connected components.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N and M. Next M lines: directed edges u v.

problems.title: Subset Sum Possible
problems.statement: Given **N** positive integers and a target **T**, determine if some subset sums exactly to **T**.
problems.inputDescription: Line 1: N and T. Line 2: N positive integers.

problems.title: N Queens Count
problems.statement: Place **N** queens on an **N×N** chessboard so no two attack each other. Print the number of distinct solutions.
problems.inputDescription: One integer N.
